row:
TamMar Equine Rescue and Transport is located in Ontario. We rescue horses who have nowhere else to go, and we nurse them back to health and adopt them out. We specialize in draft horses but will help any horse in need that crosses our paths.

We also offer professional trailering services all throughout Canada.
